questions.question: Which state became the first in India to achieve 100% digitisation of voter rolls under the Special Intensive Revision (SIR)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Rajasthan has become the first state in India to digitise 100% of its voter rolls under SIR.**
 
• **The milestone was announced by Chief Electoral Officer Navin Mahajan.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajasthan completed full digitisation of electoral rolls.**
 
• It leads the country in voter mapping with over 97% completion.
 
• This reduces documentation requirements during claims-objections phase.
 
• Draft electoral roll publication scheduled for December 16.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **SIR**__ – Special Intensive Revision, a large-scale voter roll verification and update process.
 
• High-quality mapping improved transparency and reduced repeat verification.
 
• Approximately only 30 voters per booth may need to submit documents.
 
• BLOs, panchayat staff, and officers played a key role in execution.

questions.question: Who won the 2025 Formula One World Championship?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Lando Norris.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Lando Norris was crowned the 2025 Formula One World Champion after the Abu Dhabi season finale.**
 
• **Despite Max Verstappen winning the race, Norris secured enough points with a P3 finish to take the title.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lando Norris became World Champion for the first time in 2025.**
 
• He races for McLaren and finished third in the final race to secure the championship.
 
• McLaren also sealed the Teams' Championship this season.
 
• The title marks McLaren’s first drivers’ championship in over a decade.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Max Verstappen**__ won the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix 2025 but missed the championship despite his fifth Yas Marina victory.
 
• __**Oscar Piastri**__ finished second in the final race, playing a key strategic role for McLaren.
 
• Charles Leclerc and George Russell fought behind, but couldn’t influence the title outcome.
 
• Norris overcame a season setback including a DNF at Zandvoort where he trailed by 34 points earlier.

questions.question: Who was awarded the first-ever FIFA Peace Prize?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Donald Trump**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Donald Trump received the first-ever FIFA Peace Prize on 5 December 2025 during the 2026 FIFA World Cup draw in Washington, D.C.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The award was presented by FIFA President Gianni Infantino.**
 
• **This is a newly launched award under FIFA’s “social responsibility” programme.**
 
• **The prize aims to recognise contributions that promote peace and unity through sports diplomacy.**
 
• **The selection committee and award justification have drawn global scrutiny and debate.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Award Components**__

 __
 
• Trophy
 
• Medal
 
• Certificate
 
 
 
• **Event**__
 __
 
• Presented during the 2026 FIFA World Cup draw at the Kennedy Center, Washington, D.C.
 
 
 
• **Programme Background**__
 __
 
• Award is part of FIFA’s expanding social responsibility initiatives.
 
• Focuses on recognising individuals contributing to unity through sports.
 
 
 
• **Debate**__
 
 
• Global analysts have questioned the award criteria and transparency of the selection process.

questions.question: Under which initiative was the world's highest war memorial at Galwan developed?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharat Ranbhoomi Darshan initiative.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India inaugurated the world's highest war memorial at Galwan, Ladakh, five years after the 2020 clash with China.**
 
• **The memorial stands near the KM-120 post on the strategic Durbuk-Shyok-Daulat Beg Oldie Road.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The memorial has been developed under the Bharat Ranbhoomi Darshan initiative.**
 
• It was inaugurated by Defence Minister Rajnath Singh.
 
• The site honours the 20 soldiers who laid down their lives at Galwan in 2020.
 
• The structure includes an eternal flame, museum, gallery, and 20 bronze statues.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Galwan Valley Clash (2020)**__ – A deadly confrontation between Indian and Chinese troops on June 15, 2020.
 
• Fought without firearms due to prior border agreements under LAC protocols.
 
• The war memorial is built using red and black granite symbolizing sacrifice and valour.
 
• The memorial design includes trishul, damru elements, and a triangular energy installation, with tourism facilities developed nearby.

questions.question: Who released the National Strategy for Financial Inclusion (NSFI) 2025–30?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sanjay Malhotra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra released the National Strategy for Financial Inclusion (NSFI) 2025–30, approved by the Sub-Committee of the Financial Stability and Development Council.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The NSFI 2025–30 outlines five strategic objectives called “Panch-Jyoti”, supported by 47 action points.**
 
• **The strategy focuses on equitable, responsible, suitable, and affordable financial services to ensure household and micro-enterprise security.**
 
• **It adopts a gender-sensitive approach to strengthen women-led financial inclusion and supports vulnerable households.**
 
• **The framework emphasises financial education to promote financial discipline and informed decision-making.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Key Focus Areas of NSFI 2025–30**__

 __
 
• Strengthening grievance redressal and customer protection mechanisms.
 
• Synergising livelihood opportunities, skill development, and ecosystem linkages with financial inclusion programs.
 
• Enhancing financial resilience among underserved populations.
 
 
 
• **Development Process**__
 __
 
• Prepared by the Technical Group on Financial Inclusion and Financial Literacy.
 
• Formulated after extensive stakeholder consultations across India.
 
 
 
• **National Financial Inclusion Objectives**__
 __
 
• Improve access to affordable financial services.
 
• Promote trust, transparency, and responsible financial behaviour.
 
• Strengthen institutional coordination under FSDC sub-committee guidance.
 
 
 
• **Importance of the Strategy**__
 
 
• Aims to build a secure, inclusive, and transparent financial ecosystem.
 
• Supports long-term financial stability and economic empowerment of households.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the new Chairman of the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC)? (Dec 2025)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Vivek Chaturvedi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Government of India has appointed Vivek Chaturvedi, a 1990-batch IRS (Customs & Indirect Taxes) officer, as the new Chairman of the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **His appointment was approved by the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC).**
 
• **Vivek Chaturvedi has more than 30 years of experience in indirect taxes, policy formulation, compliance, and institutional leadership.**
 
• **Before joining CBIC as Member, he served as Principal Director General of Vigilance and Chief Vigilance Officer.**
 
• **He succeeds Sanjay Kumar Agarwal, a 1988-batch IRS officer who retired on 28 November 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Vivek Chaturvedi**__

 __
 
• 1990-batch IRS officer (Customs & Indirect Taxes).
 
• Known for strengthening internal vigilance, transparency, and administrative discipline.
 
• Led reforms in internal controls and compliance during his Vigilance tenure.
 
 
 
• **Role of CBIC Chairman**__
 __
 
• Heads India’s indirect tax administration, including GST, customs, and central excise.
 
• Oversees policy implementation, compliance, enforcement, and taxpayer services.
 
 
 
• **About Former Chairman Sanjay Kumar Agarwal**__
 __
 
• 1988-batch IRS officer.
 
• Retired on 28 November 2025 after completing his term.
 
• Contributed to strengthening GST systems and improving customs processes.
 
 
 
• **Institutional Context**__
 
 
• CBIC operates under the Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance.
 
• Plays a central role in tax policy, trade facilitation, and revenue generation.

questions.question: Who inaugurated the Sharadchandra Pawar Centre of Excellence in Artificial Intelligence in Baramati and described NCP (SP) chief Sharad Pawar as his mentor?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Gautam Adani.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Industrialist Gautam Adani inaugurated the Sharadchandra Pawar Centre of Excellence in Artificial Intelligence in Baramati and called Sharad Pawar his mentor.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The Sharadchandra Pawar Centre of Excellence in Artificial Intelligence was inaugurated in Baramati.**
 
• The centre has been funded by the Adani Group and established under Vidya Pratishthan, run by the Pawar family.
 
• Gautam Adani publicly acknowledged Sharad Pawar as his mentor, citing a relationship spanning over three decades.
 
• The initiative aims to promote applied research and integrated development in artificial intelligence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Sharadchandra Pawar Centre of Excellence in AI__

 __
 
• Established to advance research, engineering and application of artificial intelligence.
 
• Envisioned as a hub for innovation and technological capability building.
 
• Located in Baramati, Maharashtra.
 
 
 
• Vidya Pratishthan__
 __
 
• An educational trust run by the Pawar family.
 
• Plays a key role in educational and skill development initiatives in Baramati.
 
• Hosts multiple institutions focused on higher education and technology.
 
 
 
• Political Context__
 
 
• Leaders from the Pawar family praised Adani’s contributions during the event.
 
• The Opposition Maha Vikas Aghadi alleged Adani’s role in the NCP split.
 
• The event sparked political debate alongside its technological focus.

questions.question: Which Indian state won its maiden Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy title by defeating Haryana in the 2025 final?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Jharkhand.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Jharkhand defeated Haryana to win the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy 2025.**
 
• **The final was played in Pune on December 18, 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Jharkhand won its maiden Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy title.**
 
• **The team defeated Haryana by 69 runs in the final.**
 
• **Ishan Kishan scored a record 101 in the title clash.**
 
• **This marked Jharkhand’s second major domestic cricket title.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy**__ – India’s premier domestic T20 cricket tournament.
 
• Jharkhand’s first domestic title came in the Vijay Hazare Trophy in 2010–11.
 
• The team suffered only one defeat during the 2025 tournament.
 
• The victory highlighted Jharkhand’s consistency and depth in domestic cricket.
